meta.name: appllama-app-design-skill
meta.description: Build native-feeling, benchmark-quality mobile app screens (Expo / React Native). Use when designing or implementing any mobile UI — screens, flows, onboarding, paywalls, tab bars, sheets, settings, empty states — or when polishing motion, navigation, typography, dark mode, or perceived performance. Enforces Apple HIG fidelity, semantic colors, native controls, anti-slop discipline, navigation semantics (push vs replace, modal vs sheet vs overlay, the one-way doors where back must not exist), purposeful Reanimated motion, a full-motion simulator-verified iteration loop, and a study-real-apps-first workflow (pairs with the Appllama MCP). Trigger on "build a screen", "make this screen better", "design the onboarding", "wire up this flow", "polish the UI", "make it feel native", or any mobile design/implementation task.

copy.tagline: 做出接近系统原生的手机 App 界面
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你正在开发手机 App,希望界面好看且操作像原生系统一样顺手。
copy.tagline_en: Create mobile app screens with native-level polish and usability.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you build mobile apps and care about screens feeling polished and native.

howto.what: 装上后，做移动端界面任务时，Claude 会先研究同类头部 App 的真实屏幕，再产出或修改 Expo/React Native 界面；并遵循平台语义颜色、原生控件与导航语义，避开常见的 AI 模板风格。
howto.when: 当对话涉及移动端 UI 的设计或实现（屏幕、引导、弹层等），或要求打磨动效、导航、排版等时触发；也可直接说 “build a screen”“polish the UI” 这类话。

say.text: 帮我设计新用户引导流程，做出来像 iOS 原生的界面。
say.note: 技能会先研究同类场景再动手。

say.text: 别用自绘控件，把这里换成系统原生滑动开关。
say.note: 对应技能里的原生控件规则。

say.text: 把付款流程改成完成后不能通过返回再次进入。
say.note: 对应技能的一次性门规则。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude starts mobile-UI work by studying real screens from top apps, then produces or revises Expo/React Native screens. It follows platform semantic colors, native controls and navigation semantics, and avoids generic AI-template styling.
howto.when_en: Triggers on mobile UI design or implementation (a screen, an onboarding flow, etc.) or on polishing motion, navigation, typography, etc. You can also say "build a screen" or "polish the UI".

say_en.text: Design our onboarding flow so it feels close to native iOS.
Use native controls and platform colors on this screen.
Rework navigation so this payment step cannot be reached via back.
